'''Hella Thimram''' was a member of a [[Thimram family|wealthy noble family]] from the planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="byss" /> She was known as a bold-speaking, hands-on leader who served as the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] of [[ChandrilTech]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She had taken over the position from [[Hella Thimram's grandfather|her grandfather]] and led the company for over a decade, earning widespread respect across Chandrila. Her practical leadership style and sharp business acumen made her a popular figure among the planet’s citizens, who considered her a symbol of Chandrilan pride.<ref name="Strongholds" />

When a Chandrilian [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] became associated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], many Chandrilians encouraged Thimram to run for the now-vacant [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Senate]] seat. Despite significant public support, she declined the nomination. Instead, [[Canna Omonda]] was elected. Following Omonda’s execution for treason by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], Thimram’s eldest son, [[Savuud Thimram|Savuud]], replaced her on the position of Senator – largely propelled by the enduring strength of his mother’s reputation.<ref name="Strongholds" />
